## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `openai-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Log in to the OpenAI Platform

1. <!-- manual: Visit [platform.openai.com](https://platform.openai.com/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Sign in with your credentials or create a new account. -->

## Step 3: Create a project

1. <!-- manual: Select your profile icon in the top-right corner. -->
2. In the dropdown menu, select **Your Profile**.
3. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Projects section from the sidebar. -->
4. Select **Create Project** and provide a name.
5. <!-- manual: Select Create Project and provide a name. -->

## Step 4: Create an API key

1. Navigate to the **API Keys** section from the sidebar and select **+ Create new secret key**.
2. <!-- manual: Provide a name for the key (for example, Connector Key), select your project, and confirm. -->
3. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
